6ebb894397f79e37.description: وصف الوظيفة: الغرض من الوظيفة : الإشراف على تحديد وتنمية وإدارة الشراكات والتحالفات الإستراتيجية لدفع نمو المركز وتعزيز مكانته التنافسية وتحقيق أهداف العمل والتعاون مع أصحاب المصلحة الداخليين والخارجيين لتطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات ومبادرات الشراكة وبناء والحفاظ على علاقات قوية مع الشركاء الرئيسيين، وتعزيز بيئة تعاونية ومتبادلة المنفعة. بالإضافة إلى حوكمة الشراكات الإستراتيجية وقيادة تطوير والحفاظ على مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية لقياس نجاح وتأثير الشراكات. الأدوار والمسؤوليات التخصصية : قيادة تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجية إدارة الشراكات الاستراتيجية بما يتماشى مع استراتيجية المركز من خلال تطوير وإدارة تنفيذ مبادرات ومشاريع الإدارات. ﻿﻿الإشراف على تحديد الشركاء المحتملين وترتيب أولوياتهم بناءً على أهميتهم وقيمتهم بالنسبة للمركز وملاءمة السوق والمواءمة الإستراتيجية والفوائد المحتملة. ﻿﻿تطوير علاقات عمل قوية مع الجهات الحكومية والخاصة ذات الصلة في المملكة العربية السعودية وبناء شراكات عميقة لتعزيز الأهداف الوطنية. ﻿﻿التعاون مع الشركاء لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة وتعظيم القيمة من الشراكة. التعاون مع الإدارات المختلفة، بما في ذلك التسويق وتطوير المنتجات والعمليات، لضمان التنفيذ الفعال لمبادرات الشراكة. إدارة توقعات الشركاء والامتثال لجميع الالتزامات التعاقدية. قيادة المفاوضات مع الشركاء المحتملين لوضع الشروط والأحكام والاتفاقيات. الإشراف على تطوير والحفاظ على مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية لقياس نجاح وتأثير الشراكات. توجيه وتحديد المخاطر المحتملة المرتبطة بالشراكات وتطوير استراتيجيات التخفيف منها ومعالجة التحديات والقضايا التي قد تنشأ خلال دورة حياة الشراكة بشكل استباقي. ﻿الإشراف على تطوير وإدارة ميزانية الشراكات، بما في ذلك النفقات المتعلقة بإدارة علاقات الشركاء والمبادرات المشتركة. تطوير وتحديد المجالات التي يمكن للشركاء المساعدة فيها في توسيع عروض المركز أو قاعدة العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات للوظيفة : درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال، الإدارة المؤسسية، التسويق أو ما يعادلها 8سنوات خبرة كحد أدنى في نفس المجال أو المجالات ذات العلاقة ﻿﻿الشهادات المهنية مثل PMP. 6e30aefbfea6f369.description: Job description Group overview: Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we operate construction and manufacturing businesses, design & development centers and a host of facilities in the Middle East and other countries. alfanar is involved in: • Electrical, Electromechanical and Civil Engineering Construction • Manufacturing and Marketing Electrical Construction Products • Allied Engineering Services Our Main Divisions: • alfanar electric • alfanar Construction • alfanar Building Systems alfanar Construction alfanar Construction is classified as a Grade I contractor by the Contractors Classification Committee of the Government of Saudi Arabia. alfanar Construction is an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) company with a track record of consistent growth. We have emerged as a strong EPC contractor in the Energy, Infrastructure as well as Engineering Services sectors in Saudi Arabia. With the support of special purpose service units, alfanar Construction continuously strives to provide appropriate and timely solutions to clients, conforming to international standards. The core EPC activities of alfanar Construction are in the fields of: • Power and Water Projects • Transmission and Distribution Projects • Building Construction (Industrial & Commercial) Projects • Electro-Mechanical projects Job Purpose To lead and manage the end-to-end tendering process for civil construction and EPC projects, ensuring technically compliant, commercially competitive, and risk-adjusted bid submissions. The role is responsible for tender strategy, cost estimation, proposal development, contract review, stakeholder coordination, and tender team leadership, with a strong focus on the Saudi Arabian market. Key Accountability Areas Tender Management and Proposal Development Lead the complete tendering lifecycle, from initial tender review and bid/no-bid assessment through proposal preparation, approval, and submission. Review tender documents, specifications, scope of work, BOQs, drawings, and contractual requirements. Coordinate the preparation and finalization of technical and commercial proposals in collaboration with engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and other relevant departments. Ensure all submissions meet client requirements, tender deadlines, company procedures, and applicable standards. Cost Estimation and Commercial Management Lead BOQ analysis, cost estimation, pricing strategy, and preparation of detailed tender cost breakdowns. Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations to ensure competitive pricing and alignment with the project scope. Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial exposures, and recommend appropriate qualifications or deviations. Participate in commercial negotiations, claims reviews, change orders, and contractual clarifications. Risk Assessment and Bid Strategy Identify technical, commercial, contractual, financial, and schedule-related risks associated with each tender. Develop risk registers and mitigation strategies for major bids. Highlight critical contractual provisions, including liquidated damages, payment terms, scope ambiguities, and project constraints. Provide management with clear recommendations to support bid/no-bid decisions and improve bid competitiveness Post-Award Handover and Execution Support Ensure a comprehensive handover of tender documents, cost breakdowns, assumptions, exclusions, quotations, and technical clarifications to the Supply Chain and Execution departments. Support post-award clarification of tender scope, pricing assumptions, and contractual commitments. Coordinate with execution, planning, project controls, and contracts teams to support alignment between tender estimates and project budgets. Contribute to value engineering, change management, and lessons learned from completed tenders. Reporting, Quality, and Market Intelligence Maintain accurate tender records, bid status reports, cost information, and post-bid analyses. Monitor market trends, competitor positioning, client requirements, and opportunities within the relevant construction sectors. Establish standardized tendering procedures, review checklists, and quality controls to ensure complete and compliant submissions. Identify opportunities to improve estimating accuracy, tendering efficiency, and bid success rates. Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 18 years of experience in civil tendering and estimation. Minimum 15 years of professional experience in the Saudi Arabian market. Proven experience managing large-scale and technically complex tenders for reputable construction companies. Strong exposure to EPC tendering and civil works associated with infrastructure, building, power generation, water, defense, and oil & gas projects. Demonstrated experience leading tendering teams and managing the complete bid lifecycle. Role Accountability HR Proficiency: Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management. Ability to recognize low performers and guide them to improve or release them. Ability to treat subordinates equally without any discrimination. Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results. Ensure availability of delegation of authority matrix to have sufficient delegations as per company policy. Responsibility: Must take full responsibility for his operation as per the job description and the required deliverables from this position, taking into consideration the general company guidelines. Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions. Delivery: Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost. Making a Tangible Difference: Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations. Business Planning and Performance: Able to transform the corporate goals into business plans. Able to Plan, follow-up and execute those plans, whether they are annual or development plans. Monitor the plan performance and initiate action to strengthen results and take the corrective action accordingly. Provide periodic work progress reports. Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency. Organizational Development: Develop the organizational structure according to the current requirements taking into consideration future and development plans. Ensure availability of job descriptions for all job roles and deployment. Business Process Improvements: Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible. Should be conversant and able to navigate through IT solutions especially those relevant to his job and business. Promote the automated systems and using them fully, to spread its culture. Quality: Quality is considered as alfanar’s prime competitive advantage as such, managers are expected to act accordingly. Adaptation: Adapt to new and alternative techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Health, Safety and Environment: Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment as per the standard regulations. Academic Qualification Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering Work Experience 10-15 years Technical / Functional Competencies Work under pressur Risk Assessment MS Office Time Management Troubleshooting Well Organized Communication Teamwork Initiative Creativity Analytical thinking Details Oriented Report writing Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

6e52e06accbe63e6.description: About International Window Company Since 2013, International Window Company has grown into an organization of over 50 professionals, delivering integrated design and build solutions. The company focuses on creating high-quality projects guided by innovation, sustainability, and long-term partnerships, addressing current client needs while supporting a resilient built environment. They combine strong technical expertise with a modern, forward-thinking mindset to provide comprehensive architectural and construction services. The Architectural Fit Out Engineer Role International Window Company is seeking an Architectural Fit Out Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with work primarily based in Jeddah. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for overseeing architectural fit-out works from design coordination through execution. The role ensures alignment with project specifications, quality standards, and local regulations. Key Responsibilities Reviewing drawings and material submittals to ensure compliance. Coordinating with architects, consultants, and contractors throughout project phases. Managing site inspections to monitor progress and quality. Resolving technical issues related to interior finishes and fit-out details. Monitoring progress against project plans to maintain schedules. Supporting cost and time control efforts for fit-out projects. Ensuring adherence to safe construction practices on site. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver functional, aesthetically aligned, and sustainable fit-out solutions. 6e19e5b5ee4e23f7.description: About the Company Established in 1972, Saudico is one of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s most reputable and long-standing construction companies. With over 52 years of continuous contribution to the nation’s development, Saudico has earned a Grade One classification from the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, reflecting its technical capability, financial strength, and proven performance. Job Description We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Sr. Structural Engineer to join our project team. The selected candidate will be responsible for overseeing structural engineering activities, reviewing structural designs, ensuring compliance with project specifications and safety standards, and supporting the successful execution of construction projects. Key Responsibilities: • Review and supervise structural engineering works to ensure compliance with approved designs and specifications. • Coordinate with consultants, architects, and project teams regarding structural requirements and technical issues. • Review structural calculations, shop drawings, and technical submittals. • Monitor site execution to ensure structural works are completed according to quality and safety standards. • Provide technical support and resolve structural-related issues during project execution. • Participate in inspections, testing activities, and project progress meetings. • Ensure compliance with local regulations, international standards, and company procedures. • Prepare technical reports and maintain proper project documentation. Qualifications & Experience: • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. • Minimum 8–12 years of relevant experience in structural engineering within construction projects. • Strong knowledge of structural analysis, design principles, and construction practices. • Experience in reviewing structural drawings, calculations, and technical documentation. • Proficiency in engineering software and Microsoft Office applications. • Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) membership is preferred/required.

This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience in civil engineering design and review. Key Responsibilities Prepare specifications for civil engineering projects. Coordinate design reviews with contractors and consultants. Manage design works in collaboration with contractors and consultants. Ensure internal coordination with other engineering disciplines. Experience and Skill Set Review EPC submitted engineering documents for Civil, Structural, and Architectural disciplines. Evaluate Master Documents List (MDL), design criteria, foundation drawings, and design calculations. Assess building layouts, architecture plans and elevations, roads, and drainage layouts. Review studies, manuals, and attend testing as required, including test procedures and reports. Review construction method statements and vendor materials procurement. Evaluate proposed vendor/supplier designs and drawings. Manage design and field changes, as-built drawings, and conduct risk assessment and mitigation. Review IFC/AFC/AFI drawings, red markup, and as-built drawings. Evaluate claims and change orders, and prepare close-out reports for LSTK Steam Power Plant Gas Conversion Projects. Oversee all design review scope and activities for base and detailed engineering submittals, drawings, and documents. The position involves working within a multidisciplinary team, coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6eb775430cca86a8.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع القصيم للأغذية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات والتقارير. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بأساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة، مع الرغبة في مواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. المهارات والكفاءات يجب أن يتمتع المرشح بالمهارات التالية لضمان الأداء الفعال في هذا الدور: الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد المستندات والتقارير المالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة وتوثيق السجلات المحاسبية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم خلاصات واضحة. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مصنع القصيم للأغذية، وتقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية للمصنع. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مصنع القصيم للأغذية.

6ebe4ec2170bd558.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن مهندس ضبط وتحكم في الجودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير وعمليات الجودة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معايير الجودة للمشروعات الهندسية والإشراف على تطبيقها بفعالية. إعداد تقارير دورية عن أداء المشاريع والمراحل الهامة القادمة. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له في سير العمل مع التقدم الفعلي، وتحليل الثغرات وتوضيح المخاطر المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ضبط وتحكم الجودة، ويفضل أن تكون في المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير وعمليات الجودة وتطبيقاتها. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير واضحة ومفصلة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل الميداني والمكتبي حسب متطلبات المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المهندسين المؤهلين الذين يبحثون عن فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية كبرى على التقديم. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر المنصة المخصصة لذلك.

6ed33507f5fa5e74.description: About Nabors Industries Nabors Industries is a leading provider of advanced technology for the energy industry, operating in approximately 20 countries. The company has established a global network of people, technology, and equipment to deliver solutions for safe, efficient, and responsible hydrocarbon production. Nabors leverages its core competencies in drilling, engineering, automation, data science, and manufacturing to innovate the future of energy and support the transition to a lower carbon world. Role Summary The QA/QC Supervisor will oversee and coordinate quality assurance and quality control activities related to the fabrication, assembly, inspection, repair, refurbishment, and testing of drilling equipment. This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role ensures compliance with approved drawings, specifications, industry standards, and the company's Quality Management System. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate QA/QC activities for Top Drive, Catwalk, Casing Drive Systems, and other drilling equipment. Ensure all inspections (receiving, in-process, final) and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) comply with approved documentation and industry standards. Manage the QA/QC team by assigning and monitoring daily inspection tasks, providing technical guidance, and reviewing inspection results. Review welding documentation, including WPS, PQR, and welder qualifications, ensuring compliance with codes and standards for welding, fabrication, NDT, and dimensional inspection. Coordinate Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), support root cause investigations, verify corrective actions, and escalate significant quality issues. Oversee supplier inspections, surveillance, first article inspections, audits, and qualification activities, monitoring supplier quality performance. Coordinate with Engineering on material substitutions, deviations, concessions, and repair dispositions, ensuring proper implementation and documentation. Review and verify all quality documentation, including inspection reports, FAT records, NDT reports, and material certificates, before product release. Ensure all measuring, inspection, and test equipment used by the QA/QC team is suitable, maintained, and calibrated. Ensure all QA/QC activities adhere to the company's Quality Management System, API Q1 requirements, and applicable API specifications. Support and participate in internal, customer, supplier, and API audits, addressing findings and monitoring corrective actions. Provide QA/QC support for equipment repair, overhaul, servicing, field activities, and warranty issues. Monitor inspection status, NCRs, supplier quality, and assigned quality KPIs, providing regular reports to Quality Management. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in inspection practices, documentation, and product quality. Exercise authority to accept or reject work, stop nonconforming work, initiate NCRs, and escalate critical quality issues. Perform duties in accordance with company policies, procedures, QMS requirements, and established quality objectives. Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Aftermarket, and other stakeholders to ensure operational effectiveness. Be accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of assigned work and for reporting any nonconformities or risks. Support and participate in achieving the organization’s Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (QHSE) objectives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant QA/QC role. Demonstrated ability to supervise and coordinate quality activities for complex equipment. Strong understanding of industry standards, specifications, and quality management systems (*, API Q1). Experience with welding and fabrication quality control, NDT, and dimensional inspection. Proficiency in managing non-conformance processes and supporting root cause investigations. Experience with supplier quality management and audits. Ability to review and verify comprehensive quality documentation. Familiarity with calibration control for measuring and test equipment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a global organization focused on advanced technology for the energy industry. Application Process Candidates interested in this QA/QC Supervisor position are encouraged to apply. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

6efcf21abd85e4f2.description: About the Role Ultra Point For Human Resource is seeking an Activities & Events Coordinator / Partnerships Manager for a full-time position in Makkah or Jeddah. This role involves organizing after-school activities, school events, and trips, alongside building partnerships with local community entities and external organizations. The primary goal is to support school objectives, enrich the student experience, and enhance parent engagement. Key Responsibilities The individual in this role will manage three core areas: Activities, Events & Trips: Develop and execute an annual calendar of events that reinforces national identity, values, and skills, ensuring quality and safety standards. This includes national occasions (National Day, Founding Day), annual events (book fairs, bazaars, graduation ceremonies, Ramadan iftars), and educational trips both within and outside the city, with secure student-release procedures. The role also covers community and career programs (giving initiatives, future careers), coordinating university visits for secondary students, and organizing participation in local educational and promotional exhibitions. After-School Clubs: Design and manage a diverse club program from planning through evaluation. Responsibilities include selecting clubs, building schedules, running club introduction days, contracting with service providers, negotiating pricing, and supervising all club activities. The role also involves arranging transportation for off-site clubs and establishing supervision and dismissal procedures. External Relations & Partnerships: Represent the school externally to attract sustainable government, private, and community partnerships that provide tangible educational value. This includes recruiting trainers and centers for clubs, workshops, and awareness programs, and coordinating with government bodies for national events (*, choir and music performances with the Ministry of Culture). The role also involves establishing environmental and community partnerships (*, waste recycling), preparing contracts with HR, and following up on and renewing partnerships. Additionally, the coordinator will create student volunteering opportunities via the Tatawa platform. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in activities coordination, event management, or partnerships. Demonstrated ability to organize and manage diverse programs and events. Experience in building and maintaining external relationships and partnerships. 6e366012f949ae48.description: About Red Sea Global and Corallium Red Sea Global (RSG) is developing Corallium, a new attraction at Amaala’s Triple Bay in Al Wajh, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. Corallium focuses on marine education, environmental regeneration, and immersive storytelling, aiming to set a global benchmark in ocean experience and stewardship. This initiative aligns with RSG’s vision for responsible tourism, sustainability, and regeneration. Every role at Corallium contributes to its mission, from planning to guest delivery. Role Overview The Retail Specialist is responsible for delivering a professional retail experience at Corallium. This full-time role involves welcoming and assisting guests, processing point-of-sale transactions accurately, and providing product recommendations. The specialist will also support the cross-promotion of the attraction's activities to enhance the guest experience and contribute to revenue generation. Candidates should have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Greet guests in a professional manner, adhering to the attraction's service standards. Provide accurate product information to assist guests with purchasing decisions. Process sales transactions efficiently using the point-of-sale (POS) system, including various payment methods. Actively cross-sell and upsell retail products to maximize sales opportunities. Promote the attraction's activities and offerings to encourage guest participation and increase revenue. Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing retail space, ensuring proper product display and stock levels. Monitor and replenish stock, reporting low inventory to the supervisor promptly. Handle guest complaints professionally, escalating issues to the supervisor when necessary. Process returns, exchanges, and refunds in accordance with company policy. Ensure till accuracy and adhere to cash handling procedures at the beginning and end of each shift. Participate in stock counts, audits, and inventory checks as required. Comply with all health, safety, and operational policies and procedures. Work Environment and Context This role operates within a fast-paced retail environment that involves direct customer interaction. The Retail Specialist will support daily store operations, contribute to sales targets, and participate in customer satisfaction initiatives. The position may require flexible working hours, including weekends, public holidays, and peak retail periods. Collaboration with store management, sales associates, and support functions is integral to achieving business objectives. Financial Responsibilities The Retail Specialist is responsible for contributing to individual and store sales targets. This includes supporting inventory control and stock accuracy to minimize losses and shrinkage. The role contributes to revenue growth through effective product promotion and upselling, and requires compliance with company policies regarding cash handling and financial transactions.

6e5df3f396ec29fc.job_title: Discipline Manager Civil Engineer / Senior Construction Manager
6e5df3f396ec29fc.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking an experienced professional for the position of Superintendent – Civil. This full-time role is with a leading company in Saudi Arabia and requires a strong background in civil engineering within the oil and gas industry. Role Overview The Superintendent – Civil will be responsible for overseeing civil engineering aspects within the oil and gas sector. This position requires a professional with extensive experience in engineering and design, particularly with PMC (Project Management Consultancy) background, to ensure successful project execution and compliance with industry standards. Key Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience within the oil and gas industry. Demonstrated strong background in engineering and design. Previous experience in a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment is essential. About NES Global Talent NES Fircroft (NES) is a global engineering staffing provider with over 90 years of combined experience. The company serves various sectors including Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining, and Manufacturing. With more than 80 offices across 45 countries, NES provides engineering and technical expertise to clients worldwide. Contractor Support NES offers comprehensive support to contractors, extending beyond traditional recruitment services. This includes assistance with securing visas and work permits, providing market-leading benefits packages, and arranging accommodation, ensuring contractors can support clients safely and compliantly. Application Process Candidates who possess the relevant experience and are interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply with their updated CV.

6e8c82c891c45347.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منارة الأفق للتموين فرع شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن نادل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمة ممتازة للعملاء وضمان تجربة طعام مريحة ومنظمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وتقديم قوائم الطعام والمشروبات لهم. الإجابة على استفسارات العملاء بوضوح واحترافية. إعداد الطاولات وترتيبها وتنظيفها قبل وبعد الاستخدام. تقديم الفواتير للعملاء واستلام وتسجيل المدفوعات بدقة. مهام تقديم الوجبات المشاركة في تجهيز مستلزمات الوجبات على خط التوزيع. توصيل عربات الوجبات إلى أقسام المرضى وتوزيعها عليهم وعلى المرافقين. تجميع الصواني والعربات من أقسام المرضى وإيصالها إلى منطقة الغسيل بالمطبخ. توزيع الوجبات في صالة الطعام (الكافتيريا) للممرضين والمناوبين. متطلبات الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطبيق الاشتراطات الصحية أثناء العمل. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وحسن التعامل عند تقديم الوجبات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمة عالية الجودة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل منارة الأفق للتموين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

6ea438494612468d.company_name: مركز ياسمين محمد حسين الرويلي للعلاج الطبيعي
6ea438494612468d.description: About the Role Alyne is seeking a Stretch Therapist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on enhancing patient mobility, flexibility, and muscular function through personalized assisted stretching and muscle work. The therapist will contribute to an exceptional patient experience within Alyne's structured patient care approach. Key Responsibilities Deliver personalized, hands-on assisted stretching and mobility sessions. Perform muscle release techniques and stretching in accordance with approved clinical protocols and professional scope. Support patients in improving flexibility, movement, and muscular function. Collaborate with Chiropractors to complement individual patient care plans as required. Maintain a clean, comfortable, and professional treatment environment. Ensure an exceptional patient experience through attentive and professional care. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or degree in Sports Science, Exercise Science, Sports Therapy, Physiotherapy, or a related field. Previous hands-on experience in assisted stretching, mobility training, or muscle work. Good understanding of anatomy, muscle groups, and human movement. Experience in assisted stretching is preferred. Knowledge of PNF stretching and myofascial techniques is preferred. Experience working with a diverse patient population is preferred. Previous experience in a stretch center, chiropractic clinic, or multidisciplinary clinic is preferred. Clinical Approach and Skills Comfortable performing hands-on muscle work and assisted stretching. Familiar with stretching techniques such as static, dynamic, and PNF stretching. Able to follow Chiropractor-directed care plans and established clinical protocols. Willingness to learn and adapt techniques to Alyne's clinical approach. Understands professional boundaries and operates within qualifications and authorized scope. Warm, personable, and confident in patient interactions. Strong communication skills and a patient-first mindset. Physically capable of performing hands-on stretching throughout the working day. Work Environment and Career Progression The Stretch Therapist reports to the Clinic Manager and works closely with Chiropractors and Clinical Assistants. This role operates within a structured clinical environment, requiring a team-oriented approach. Candidates should be culturally respectful and adaptable to local norms, maintaining an open-minded and professional demeanor. Alyne prioritizes internal promotion, offering career progression and leadership opportunities to team members who consistently demonstrate strong performance and professionalism.

6ed28ce4cf2244bb.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Commissioning Superintendent HVAC to oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of HVAC pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. This full-time position is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region, and involves working on new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. The role focuses on ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient HVAC system operation, achieving project delivery objectives, and securing client acceptance. Role Context and Scope The Commissioning Superintendent HVAC will be responsible for all aspects of HVAC systems, including accommodation, machinery, technical, hazardous area, and ventilation systems. This involves testing, startup, performance verification, and handover processes, ensuring adherence to project specifications, classification society requirements, and offshore regulatory standards for operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee pre-commissioning, commissioning, functional testing, startup, and performance verification of HVAC systems across various areas, ensuring operational readiness and project compliance. Develop, implement, and control HVAC commissioning procedures, inspection checklists, test packages, and schedules to ensure systematic execution and timely achievement of project milestones. Oversee the inspection, testing, calibration, and operational validation of HVAC components such as AHUs, chillers, compressors, fans, blowers, dampers, louvers, VFDs, and control systems. Manage the integration and functional verification of HVAC automation systems, control panels, monitoring systems, interlocks, and fire and gas interfaces. Coordinate commissioning activities with engineering, construction, QA/QC personnel, vendors, subcontractors, and client representatives for efficient issue resolution. Lead engagements with classification societies, regulatory authorities, and client representatives during inspections, testing, audits, and approvals to secure compliance certification. Ensure all HVAC commissioning activities adhere to HSE requirements, permit-to-work processes, hazardous area regulations, SOLAS, IMO, and classification society standards. Lead troubleshooting, defect identification, punch-list management, corrective actions, and performance optimization activities to achieve system completion. Oversee the preparation and control of commissioning dossiers, test records, inspection reports, ITRs, mechanical completion documentation, RFCC/RFOC certificates, and acceptance records. Direct FAT, SAT, final acceptance testing, system turnover, as-built documentation, and handover activities to ensure successful client acceptance and transition to operations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in HVAC commissioning, preferably within the offshore or maritime industry. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage complex commissioning projects. Strong understanding of HVAC systems, controls, and relevant industry standards. Work Environment This role is based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern region, and involves working on new-build offshore jack-up drilling rigs. The position requires a commitment to maintaining high safety and compliance standards in a dynamic project environment. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6e7dae497ab2dd21.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق نزل الضباب عن موظف استقبال فندق للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على خدمات الضيوف في مكتب الاستقبال وتنسيقها وتقديمها، بما في ذلك عمليات الحجز وتسجيل الدخول والخروج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الحفاظ على قائمة الحجوزات وتوفير السجلات الورقية الضرورية. العمل على رفع مستوى خدمة العملاء ورضاهم، ومتابعة المنازعات والشكاوى. ضمان تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات الفندق. تكوين علاقات تجارية قوية والحفاظ عليها مع الأطراف الأخرى، مثل وكالات السفر والحجوزات. مراجعة أسعار الفندق وتنظيم الفواتير تبعاً لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة خدمات الضيوف بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الفندق لتقديم خدمات الاستقبال للضيوف. عن فندق نزل الضباب فندق نزل الضباب هو منشأة فندقية تسعى لتقديم أفضل الخدمات لضيوفها. يلتزم الفندق بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم تطوير الموظفين وتقدم تجربة مميزة للعملاء. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل فندق نزل الضباب، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

6e61eba09a21bc45.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الركين عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير دعم ومساندة للعملاء من خلال استقبال استفساراتهم ومتابعة طلباتهم، مما يضمن تقديم تجربة خدمة عملاء احترافية تعزز رضا العملاء وثقتهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال اتصالات العملاء واستفساراتهم عبر الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني أو نظام التذاكر المعتمد. فتح تذاكر الدعم الفني وتحويلها إلى الجهات المختصة ومتابعتها حتى إغلاقها. متابعة حالة العميل بعد التركيب أو الصيانة والتأكد من رضاه عن الخدمة المقدمة. تنسيق المواعيد مع فرق الدعم الفني أو التركيب الميداني وفقًا لجدول العمل. توثيق جميع التفاعلات مع العملاء بدقة عبر النظام المعتمد. تقديم تقارير دورية عن ملاحظات العملاء والشكاوى المتكررة لمدير قسم التشغيل. إرسال الإشعارات والتحديثات الفنية أو التشغيلية للعملاء عند الحاجة. الالتزام باستخدام البريد الإلكتروني كوسيلة رسمية للتواصل مع العملاء. المساهمة في تحسين تجربة العملاء من خلال اقتراح حلول وتحسينات للخدمة. التواصل الدوري مع العملاء والتحقق من مستوى الرضا عن الخدمات المقدمة. المشاركة في الحملات التوعوية أو التدريبية لرفع مستوى وعي العملاء بالخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء. القدرة على استخدام الوسائل الرسمية المعتمدة مثل نظام التذاكر والبريد الإلكتروني. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لضمان التفاعل الفعال مع العملاء والفرق الداخلية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق في مدينة الرياض، ويكون مسؤولاً عن التنسيق مع الفرق الفنية لضمان تقديم الدعم المطلوب للعملاء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية وقدرة على متابعة المهام المتعددة. القدرة على حل المشكلات وتقديم الدعم الفعال للعملاء. الالتزام بالاحترافية في التعامل مع العملاء. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة الركين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذا الدور بدوام كامل في الرياض.

6e75f27ae593c2cf.description: Chief Electrical Engineer Role at Libera Consultants Libera Consultants is partnering with a leading organization in the energy/industrial sector to recruit a Chief Electrical Engineer. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region, and involves leading and overseeing large-scale electrical engineering projects. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with the Principal Electrical Engineer to ensure accurate implementation of project designs. Lead and manage the work of Lead Engineers across multiple projects. Prepare and review electrical engineering studies, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Resolve complex engineering challenges in line with international codes and standards. Define project scope, objectives, and priorities. Plan, schedule, and monitor departmental workload. Establish and maintain procedures, methods, and quality controls. Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards. Liaise with internal teams and external clients. Leadership and Team Management Manage, mentor, and develop the Electrical Engineering team. Support recruitment, training, and performance management initiatives. Contribute to departmental budgeting and resource planning. Review performance and recommend salary adjustments. Approve timesheets and oversee team productivity. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Master’s Degree preferred). Registered Professional Engineer. Minimum of 25 years’ experience in Electrical Engineering. Proven experience in oil & gas, hydrocarbon, refinery, offshore, or infrastructure projects. Recognized as a specialist on large to mega-scale projects. Required Expertise Strong expertise in electrical engineering design and practices. Proficiency in protection systems and calculations. In-depth knowledge of international codes, standards, and specifications. Application Process Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

6ef43258a0837216.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a skilled CAD Operator to support a major transport infrastructure and utilities supervision project. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically within King Abdullah Economic City, Jeddah, or Makkah itself. The role involves preparing and updating engineering drawings in coordination with multidisciplinary teams. Role Context and Purpose The CAD Operator will be responsible for the preparation, modification, and management of engineering drawings related to roads, utilities, and infrastructure works. This position requires strong experience in transport infrastructure projects that involve both dry and wet utility networks, ensuring all drawings comply with project standards and client requirements. Key Responsibilities Prepare, revise, and maintain CAD drawings for roads, utilities, and infrastructure works. Develop and update shop drawing records, as-built drawings, and construction documentation. Coordinate with engineers, inspectors, and project teams to incorporate design and site changes. Ensure compliance with project drafting standards, procedures, and quality requirements. Maintain drawing registers and document control processes. Support multidisciplinary coordination across utility and roadway packages. Review contractor-submitted CAD drawings for completeness and accuracy. Generate plan, profile, cross-section, and utility layout drawings. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as a CAD Operator. Extensive experience in transport infrastructure and utility projects. Proficiency in preparing and updating engineering drawings. Demonstrated experience with projects involving dry and wet utility networks. Company Overview WSP is a global engineering and professional services firm. Joining WSP means becoming part of a team focused on shaping future communities.

6e174bff9e7acc96.description: About the Role Mondelēz International is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 year of experience, focusing on developing customer relationships and optimizing sales performance. Role Purpose and Impact The Sales Executive will be responsible for building professional relationships with customers to enhance base sales, support new product development (NPD), and manage promotional activities. A key aspect of this role involves ensuring strong product visibility in retail environments and contributing to the delivery of sales capabilities. The individual will be driven to meet field KPIs and achieve annual objectives. Key Responsibilities Ensure maximum visual impact and optimal shelf availability through effective merchandising techniques. Implement and monitor promotional activities in retail locations. Oversee the placement and implementation of point-of-buying materials. Prepare and submit reports on sales activities and performance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. This role requires individuals who are detail-oriented and demonstrate perseverance in achieving sales targets. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Solid understanding of sales and negotiation processes. Strong analytical abilities. Demonstrated perseverance and attention to detail. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to a global snacking company.

6e7fede9455610e4.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is a Saudi developer and investment holding company leading large-scale entertainment, sports, and culture destinations, including the Qiddiya mega-project. Working at the forefront of the real estate sector, the company is shaping ambitious destinations through complex, high-impact development initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to landmark projects that bring together long-term vision, rigorous planning, and coordinated delivery across multiple stakeholders and disciplines. As Senior Manager - Development, you will play a key role in driving major development initiatives from early planning through execution. You will help shape decisions that influence project direction, delivery strategy, and overall development outcomes while working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners across the project lifecycle. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale development projects. Manage project budgets, schedules, risks, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, and contractors through delivery milestones. Conduct feasibility studies and market assessments to support development decisions. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project governance. Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related field. 9-12 years of experience managing large-scale real estate or development projects, including mixed-use and large-scale masterplan developments. Strong experience with project budgeting, scheduling, and risk management. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and external delivery partners. Experience working closely with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and senior internal decision-makers. Hands-on experience with Excel-based financial modeling or reporting platforms such as Power BI. Native-level English proficiency.

6ee4aba010511079.description: تبحث مقهانا المرموق عن باريستا موهوب وشغوف للانضمام إلى فريقنا المبتكر. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد وتقديم قهوة استثنائية لعملائنا مع ضمان تجربة عملاء لا تُنسى. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وشغفًا بالقهوة، وقدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تحضير أنواع مختلفة من مشروبات القهوة بدقة واحترافية. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وسريعة، والتعامل مع استفسارات العملاء وطلباتهم. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل ومعدات القهوة. * المساهمة في تطوير قائمة المشروبات وتقديم اقتراحات مبتكرة. * العمل بروح الفريق الواحد لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة.

6e74adbbc5137b8e.description: About Cenomi Retail Founded in 1990 as Fawaz Alhokair Fashion Retail Co., Cenomi Retail has established itself by introducing over 80 international retail and F&B brands to Saudi Arabia. The company operates more than 1,600 stores across 100 shopping centers in 11 countries, including well-known brands such as Zara, Mango, Aldo, Cinnabon, and Subway. Cenomi Retail is committed to growth and developing brand partnerships. The Role of Senior Legal Counsel Cenomi Retail is seeking a Senior Legal Counsel to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves providing practical, commercial legal advice and managing legal risks. The Senior Legal Counsel will also support the Director of Legal, Governance & Compliance on corporate and compliance matters. Key Responsibilities Drafting and negotiating various agreements. Providing commercial legal advice. Managing legal risks for the company. Supporting the Director of Legal, Governance & Compliance on corporate and compliance issues. Required Skills and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Strong drafting and negotiation skills. Ability to review and negotiate commercial agreements independently. Sound legal research and analytical capabilities. Ability to identify legal risks and provide practical recommendations. Experience managing external counsel when required. Personal Attributes Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Highly organized and proactive approach. Detail-oriented mindset. Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. 6e9f320e02f53f55.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى فني التمديدات الكهربائية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمليات الكهربائية بكفاءة وأمان. تشمل هذه المهام الجوانب الفنية والتخطيطية والصيانة: دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية بأنواعها المختلفة (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة، مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك تشغيل دارات التمديدات وفحصها، وإجراء فحوصات العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على فهم وتطبيق المعايير الفنية المتعلقة بالأنظمة الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة يجب أن يمتلك المرشح مهارات قوية في قراءة المخططات الكهربائية، والقدرة على تقدير الاحتياجات الفنية للمشاريع، بالإضافة إلى مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

ريهادوكس يومياً. تنفيذ جلسة متابعة البيئة التدريبية التابعة للخطة الإدارية على نظام ريهادوكس مرة واحدة أسبوعياً. توثيق الجلسات المعطاة في النموذج المعتمد داخل الفصل. متابعة غياب المستفيدين وتبليغ المشرف/ة. مناقشة الأهداف المشتركة مع مختصي الفصول والعيادات الأخرى لتحقيق أقصى فائدة ممكنة من الخطة التأهيلية. تفعيل دور الخدمات العيادية داخل الفصول ومتابعة التنفيذ مع مختصي الفصول وتوثيقه في النموذج المعتمد لذلك. تحديث ملف الإنجاز وإضافة الدورات والفعاليات وأوراق العمل المنفذة مع المستفيدين خلال الجلسات التدريبية. تعبئة نماذج الخطط التشغيلية الموجودة على البورد داخل العيادات حسب الأحداث المذكورة 6ec2182465f53623.description: Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, and transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average? If yes, then this is the job you are looking for , webook.com is Saudi’s #1 event ticketing and experience booking platform in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion in sales. Role Overview : webook is building the region's go-to marketplace for live events and we're looking for the commercial leader who will shape how we grow. As Trade Director, you'll build the trading function from a blank page: the strategy, the team, the frameworks, and the results. You'll own the P&L, set the commercial tempo for the business, and have a direct line to the CCO. If you've done this before and want to do it bigger this is that role. Key Responsibilities Own the e-commerce trading calendar planning, prioritising, and executing revenue-generating activity across the webook.com events marketplace. Set and manage commercial KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, AOV, promotional ROI, inventory sell-through, and repeat purchase rate. Build webook.com pricing and promotions framework, defining how discounts, bundles, and incentive structures are applied and evaluated. Lead the Trading Team recruiting, onboarding, and developing three direct reports. Partner with Marketing to align trading activity with acquisition campaigns and seasonal moments. Work with Product to surface commercial requirements for the platform roadmap. Collaborate with Operations to translate supply landscape into executable trading plans. Report trading performance to the CCO weekly and monthly with clear analysis and recommendations. Establish a test-and-learn culture with structured A/B testing across offers, pricing, and merchandising. Experience 8+ years of experience in ecommerce trading, merchandising, or commercial management, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role. Proven track record of owning and growing a trading P&L within a marketplace, retail, or ticketing/events platform. Experience building and scaling a trading or commercial function, including hiring and developing teams. Background working in fast-paced, high-growth environments with cross-functional accountability. Prior exposure to the events, ticketing, or live entertainment sector is a strong advantage. Skills & Capabilities Strong commercial acumen with deep understanding of pricing strategy, promotional mechanics, and margin management. Data-driven mindset: confident interpreting performance data, building dashboards, and translating insights into trading decisions. Experience designing and running A/B tests and structured experiments to optimise conversion, AOV, and promotional ROI. Ability to build and maintain a dynamic trading calendar aligned with marketing campaigns and seasonal demand patterns. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to present performance and strategy clearly to senior leadership. Proficiency with analytics and trading tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Tableau, Excel/Sheets, or similar BI platforms). Leadership Demonstrated ability to recruit, onboard, and develop high-performing commercial teams. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure from scratch in a scale-up environment. A collaborative leader who can influence without authority across Marketing, Product, and Operations. Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and a focus on measurable outcomes.

6ee004c658039bf2.description: Eram Talent is looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented IT Asset Management Analyst to join our operations in Saudi Arabia. The IT Asset Management Analyst is also responsible for receiving, tagging, disposing the assets, updating the Assets database system, as well as developing and implementing procedures for tracking IT assets to oversee quality control throughout their lifecycles. Key Responsibilities Manage the entire lifecycle of IT assets, including acquisition, inventory management, utilization tracking, and disposal. Manage the complete IT asset lifecycle including receiving, tagging, tracking, loaning, repairing, and disposal of assets. Maintain accurate asset records (custodian, warranty, status, refresh, and end-of-life) in the asset management system. Conduct physical and system inventory audits, analyze variances, and ensure data accuracy. Control asset acquisition, storage, movement, and disposal in coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Prepare asset reports and dashboards and support process improvements and governance. Stay current with industry trends and best practices in IT asset management. 6e80194a0e56910c.job_title: Senior Diver & Dive Operations Supervisor (Saudi Arabia)
6e80194a0e56910c.description: We are seeking a highly organized and adaptable Diver & Dive Centre Supervisor who will report to the Lead, Marine & Dive Management and support the successful delivery of complex dive operations for the project team at NEOM. The Dive Centre Supervisor will oversee all daily dive centre operations in support of the KAUST Coral Restoration Initiative (KCRI). This role ensures safe, efficient, and high-quality dive operations that directly support coral restoration, marine monitoring, scientific diving activities, visitor engagements, and operational readiness within NEOM waters. Working closely with other Reefscape Supervisors, the Dive Centre Supervisor manages dive centre staff, ensures equipment readiness, enforces safety protocols, plans and executes dive schedules and briefings and supports training, research activities and enhancing team technical capability. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong background in dive operations management, dive safety, emergency response, equipment maintenance, team leadership, and remote-area logistics. The position will be based at NEOM. Responsibilities Directly oversee all diving operations including training, marine surveys, and coral restoration activities. Act as a dive supervisor ensuring safety protocols are strictly adhered to and all diving operations comply with KCRI SOPs and regulatory requirements. Lead a team of divers, providing training, mentoring, and support to ensure high operational standards and safety mindsets. Conduct risk assessments and develop dive plans for various operational scenarios, ensuring all aspects of diving are considered. Manage all dive equipment, including inspections, maintenance, and servicing schedules; ensure readiness for all operational tasks. Facilitate logistics for dive operations, including transportation, site preparation, and coordinating external support as needed. Maintain accurate records of dives, safety drills, training sessions, and equipment maintenance. Collaborate closely with scientists and marine biologists to support survey and restoration projects, ensuring effective dive operations. Participate in emergency preparedness drills and lead incident response initiatives. Communicate regularly with project management regarding operational progress, challenges, and safety concerns. Bachelor’s degree in Marine Sciences, Environmental Management, or a related field. Recognized dive instructor certification (PADI, SSI, CMAS, or equivalent) with at least 6 years of diving experience. Experience in a supervisory or management role within dive operations, particularly in marine restoration or research projects. Technical diving certifications such as CCR, Trimix, or equivalent advanced qualifications are strongly preferred. Proven experience in managing dive operations and equipment readiness for both recreational and professional diving tasks. Recognized emergency response qualifications (e.g., Diver Medic, DMT, Instructor Trainer) preferred. Strong knowledge of marine safety standards, diving protocols, and emergency response procedures. Demonstrated experience in dive center operations management, equipment servicing and repair, CCR and technical diving operations, remote-environment Excellent leadership and team management skills, with a focus on fostering a safety-first culture. Ability to work effectively in remote locations and adapt to changing environmental conditions.
